senses.sense_definition: One of five children born to the same mother at a single birth.

examples.text: The hospital staff celebrated the healthy delivery of each <w>quintuplet</w>.
Being a <w>quintuplet</w> meant she grew up sharing everything with four siblings.

senses.sense_definition: A group of five items or entities, especially five musical notes played in the time usually allotted to four.

examples.text: The pianist struggled to play the rapid <w>quintuplet</w> evenly against the steady tempo.
The drum rhythm features a complex <w>quintuplet</w> pattern across the bar.

senses.sense_definition: A bicycle designed to be ridden and pedaled by five people simultaneously.

examples.text: The vintage museum displayed an unusual <w>quintuplet</w> from the late nineteenth century.
Riding a heavy <w>quintuplet</w> required perfect coordination among all five cyclists.
